thread:
Emma: Urgent escalation from Acme EU — they hit a renewal/payment block. Invoice INV-2026-0423 generated in GBP for the EU subsidiary but the customer's AP team requires EUR and a PO on the invoice. Card on file was attempted and declined (payment id pay_9876543). Can payments/eng reissue in EUR + include VAT number + PO? Customer is refusing payment until invoice matches PO.

Matt: On it. Can you paste the invoice JSON or a screenshot? Need the raw response to understand currency mapping. Also: any error from the payment gateway on decline?

Olga: hi — Acme AP here. Bank declined because the card is assigned to the parent entity (US) and our EU PO system flagged the currency mismatch. We need: invoice in EUR, VAT id on invoice, PO# PO-88642. We're blocked for the month end.

Emma: Details: invoice shows currency: GBP, total: 12,345.67 GBP. Our FX conversion in notes shows 14,567.89 EUR but the line items on the invoice PDF still say GBP which causes PO mismatch. There's also a tiny FX rounding diff (0.02 EUR) compared to customer's internal calc so their PO validator rejects it.

Nina: Suspect bug in billing service: when account has a default_currency set to GBP and the entity override is empty, we fallback to account default instead of entity.country_currency. Quick repro:
```
GET /v1/invoices/INV-2026-0423
Response: { "id":"INV-2026-0423", "currency":"GBP", "account": { "default_currency":"GBP" }, "entity": { "id":"ent-eu-17", "currency": null } }
```
This causes the PDF renderer to format amounts in GBP even though entity country should force EUR.

Luis: Workaround that I can do now: reissue invoice in EUR and attach PO + VAT. I can create a one-time payment link for the reissued invoice. Steps I will run from admin:
```
POST /admin/invoices/reissue
{ "invoice_id":"INV-2026-0423", "currency":"EUR", "include_vat":true, "po_number":"PO-88642" }
// then generate payment link for pay_... retry
POST /admin/payments/create_link { "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0423-EUR" }
```
I will also include a note about the tiny FX rounding difference and round to 2 decimals to match customer's validator.

Sara: Olga — can you confirm the exact legal billing entity name and the EU VAT number to print on the invoice? If you confirm now we can reissue in the next 30–45 min and send a payment link.

Olga: Confirming: Acme EU SARL, VAT FR123456789. Please include PO-88642 on the header and the net/vat/gross breakout.

Raj: Heads up — if this is intra-EU B2B and they provide a valid VAT id, invoice should show reverse-charge language or 0% VAT with VAT id displayed depending on their country rules. Finance must ensure we don't incorrectly charge VAT. I'll sign off on the wording after reissue.

Matt: I'll take the payment retry once Luis creates the link and monitor the gateway logs. If the card continues to be blocked we can send a manual ACH/SEPA option or accept a customer credit card on a one-time link.

billing-bot: invoice_reissued INV-2026-0423 -> INV-2026-0423-EUR (status: pending_payment)

Emma: Thanks team — priority: high. Luis please reissue + add PO and VAT, Matt follow gateway logs, Raj confirm reverse-charge text. Sara will update customer with ETA. :pray:
